response.sql: WITH scan_site_joined AS (SELECT s.gbsize, s.spanmin, si.riskeval FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), group_rates AS (SELECT riskeval, SUM(gbsize) / SUM(spanmin) AS rate FROM scan_site_joined GROUP BY riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS benchmark_rate FROM group_rates), above_benchmark AS (SELECT gr.rate, b.benchmark_rate FROM group_rates gr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gr.rate > b.benchmark_rate) SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(rate - benchmark_rate) AS avg_excess FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: No group has zero total scan duration (SUM(spanmin) > 0 for all groups); otherwise the rate per group would be undefined or infinite
